event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Hot PPI, rotation out of tech.
Sept PPI printed 6.3% y/y vs 5.3% fc and 1.3% m/m vs 0.50% fc, while retail sales beat at 0.8% vs 0.30% — a stagflation-flavored mix that sank yields-and-growth, lifted small caps and defensives, and sent gold and silver ripping.

INDICES — VIX 16.5, above its 15.5 20-day MA; VIXY -0.79%.
IWM +1.37%, DIA +1.08%, SPY +0.28%, QQQ -0.13%, SOXX -0.91%. Small > large by 1.09pp. Biggest cross-asset move: silver +3.39% with oil +2.44% and 20Y Treasuries +1.37%. SPY and QQQ remain above their 200-day MAs — no CTA sell trigger.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 1.0x and QQQ 1.4x: QQQ's elevated tape with price down -0.13% is distribution, while SOXX at 2.5x with price -0.91% confirms semiconductor selling.
Gainers show RSP 1.7x and XLP 2.2x — accumulation into equal-weight and staples, not megacap. 43% of the S&P is above its 50-DMA and 51% above the 200-DMA, with adv/dec 374/126, up/down volume 1.83, and 43 new 60-day highs vs 12 lows. Breadth confirms a broad, not narrow, tape — 75% of names up despite the index barely moving.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLV Healthcare +1.86%, XLB Materials +1.79%, XLY Discretionary +1.71%, XLC Comms +1.46%, XLF Financials +1.38%, XLRE Real Estate +1.21%, XLP Staples +0.72%, XLI Industrials +0.51%, XLU Utilities -0.17%, XLK Technology -0.65%, XLE Energy -1.58%.
Top industries: GDX +4.34%, XRT +3.68%; bottom: DRAM -1.62%, OIH -1.51%, XOP -1.49%. Flows are defensive: XLP +$896mm (98th pct) and XLU +$696mm (98th pct) lead inflows against XLI -$254mm (17th pct) and XLRE -$102mm (10th pct) — directly contradicting today's REIT and industrial price strength. Money is leaving semis (SMH -$1,243mm, 4th pct) and IWM (-$1,214mm) while QQQ takes +$8,301mm (100th pct). Rotation state: AI hardware fading / high-to-low rotation.

POSITIONING — SPY put-call 1.46 signals heavy protection demand; QQQ 0.93 is neutral; IWM 0.61 is complacent into today's small-cap rally.
SPY skew +6.2% and QQQ +8.2% show put premium bid even as VIX sits at 16.5. VIXEQ 40.5 vs VIX 16.5 — a 24-point gap — is textbook high single-stock dispersion, a rotation tape, not a macro-correlated one.

CROSS-ASSET — TLT +1.37% alongside gold +1.79% and a dollar -0.41% is a classic stagflation trade: hot PPI but a soft Philly Fed (20.9 vs 28.4 fc) driving the long end.
Silver +3.39% outrunning gold points to industrial-demand beta, consistent with NY Fed Manufacturing at 25.5 vs 10.25 fc. Next FOMC Oct 28; Polymarket prices 72% no change (5-day -12pp) and 28% for a 25bp hike — hike odds firming into a 6.3% PPI.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 57.8, Neutral.
INTU +6.36% on NFL/AI/guidance, NOW +6.14% on falling Treasury yields, AEM +5.96%. Best 20d sector is XLV +4.96%, worst XLK +0.60%; Growth (IWF) sits BEAR at z-score -0.72. Vol spikes: VRT 2.9x with price -3.63% and WGMI 2.9x with price +2.66% — distribution in the buildout, accumulation in crypto miners. Watch XRT (+3.68%, 2.3x volume, retail-sales beat transmission), SOXX (2.5x distribution with 5d -8.62%), and GDX (+4.34%, leading the metals break).
